members.name: routing
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or unknown charge on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not authorise or does not recognise
criteria.compromised_card: Customer thinks their card, card details or PIN were compromised or used by someone else
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Reporting or blocking a lost or stolen card, a found card after reporting it lost, or fees disputed because the card was stolen
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen; worried about access to the app/account
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund, or to cancel a purchase or order with a merchant and get the money back
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: An expected refund has not appeared in the account
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM debited the account but dispensed no cash or not the amount wanted, e.g. 'I haven't received my cash', 'I could not get the cash I wanted', 'I got the wrong amount'
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexpected extra fee or small extra charge (e.g. an extra £1) on the statement, including a pending £1 charge not purchased
criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_arrival: New card has not arrived yet / tracking a card in the post
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes / delivery to a country
criteria.card_linking: Link a card to the app or account
criteria.card_not_working: Card is not working in general
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring; getting a replacement
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the bank's card is accepted by merchants (not whether the bank accepts the customer's credit card for top-up)
criteria.change_pin: Change or find the PIN, PIN delivery (not a PIN that may be compromised)
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after wrong attempts; unblock it
criteria.getting_spare_card: Order an additional or spare card
criteria.get_physical_card: Get or order a physical card
criteria.virtual_card: Get a virtual card or disposable virtual card; limits of disposable cards
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which cards the bank itself issues or offers: whether its card is Visa or Mastercard, what credit cards it carries, e.g. 'Can I use visa or mastercard with your service'
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Any question mentioning Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch: adding the card, topping up via them, a top-up via them not working, which currencies they accept
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment or purchase was declined or refused, including repeated declines of the card
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending or delayed, e.g. a purchase stuck for half an hour
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled, reverted or returned to the account by the bank, app or merchant after being made (not the customer asking to cancel one)
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal is still pending, or the balance does not reflect a cash withdrawal just made
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient has not received a transfer
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or was returned
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancel, undo or correct a transfer or a transaction in general, e.g. 'one of my transactions needs to be canceled', 'I made the wrong transaction'
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money or get paid into the account (not about fees)
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account, or whether a card (e.g. a credit card) can be used to transfer money
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer in
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Balance not updated after a cheque or cash deposit
criteria.top_up_methods: How to top up (steps): by bank transfer, cash or cheque, or with a card (not which card types are accepted, not Apple Pay / Google Pay)
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or card declined for top-up
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or returned
criteria.verify_top_up: Verify a top-up card / verification code for top up
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Fee charged on a card payment
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Fees for sending or receiving transfers, or a fee charged on a transfer
criteria.top_up_charge: Fees for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.card_fees: Cost or fees of getting a card: ordering a physical, additional or replacement card (including replacing a lost or stolen card)
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment or cash withdrawal, e.g. received less cash than expected because of the rate
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies are supported for holding/exchange
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (other cards, American Express, credit cards, a card from another country such as a US card) or currencies can be used to top up or add money; which cards and currencies are supported (not Apple Pay / Google Pay)
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change name, address or personal details
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Proof or verification of the source of funds, e.g. 'where do my funds come from', 'who is giving me my money'
criteria.transaction_record: Getting a receipt, statement or record of a transaction or payment
criteria.cancel_card_transaction: The customer asks to cancel a transaction explicitly made on their card, e.g. 'cancel a transaction on my debit card' (not a transaction in general, not an order with a merchant)
criteria.unrecognised_incoming_money: Unexpected money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there (not questions about proving the source of funds)
